name: Magnitude
description: You shake the ground with an earth-shattering quake. All creatures in range must make a {save}, taking half damage on a success and full damage on a fail. Creatures in range that are burrowed or in the invulnerable stage of Dig take double damage from this move. Roll a d100 on the table below to determine damage. Raised creatures are immune to the effects and damage of this move.
higherLevels: For damage rolls, use 2× Dice at level 5, 3× Dice at level 10, and 4× Dice at level 17.
